# CMU foundation takeoff: estimating conventions
- Total wall length = the sum of the outside dimensions of all sides (no deduction at the corners).
- Wall area = total wall length x wall height.
- One 8 in x 16 in (nominal) CMU covers 0.889 ft² of wall.
- CMUs to purchase = wall area / 0.889 ft², plus waste, rounded up to a whole CMU.
- Grout, all cells = CMUs before waste x grout per CMU, converted to cubic yards (27 ft³ = 1 CY), plus grout waste.
- Cells are 8 in apart, so grouting the cells at S in on center fills 8/S of the cells: grout = grout for all cells x 8 / S.

answer:
To find the quantities for the CMU foundation wall:

1. **Total wall length**: $48\text{ ft} + 48\text{ ft} + 40\text{ ft} + 40\text{ ft} = 176\text{ ft}$.
2. **Wall area**: $176\text{ ft} \times 4\text{ ft} = 704\text{ ft}^2$.
3. **Number of CMUs**: 
   - Base CMUs = $704\text{ ft}^2 / 0.889\text{ ft}^2\text{ per CMU} = 791.901\text{ CMUs}$
   - Including 6% waste = $791.901 \times 1.06 = 839.4$, rounded up to **840 CMUs**.
4. **Grout, all cells**: 
   - Total grout volume = $791.901\text{ CMUs} \times 0.17\text{ ft}^3/\text{CMU} = 134.623\text{ ft}^3$
   - In cubic yards with 5% waste = $(134.623 / 27) \times 1.05 = 5.24\text{ CY}$.
5. **Grout, cells at 32 in on center**: 
   - Fraction of cells grouted = $8 / 32 = 1/4$
   - Volume with 5% waste = $5.24\text{ CY} \times (1/4) = 1.31\text{ CY}$.

FINAL: Q1 = 840 CMU
FINAL: Q2 = 5.24 CY
FINAL: Q3 = 1.31 CY
